cells.note: Job tracker links contacts, notes and documents to each application.
Networking tracker keeps contacts in one dashboard, categorized by company, industry or role, with import from LinkedIn, email or CSV.
Members set reminders for each connection to follow up.
Page says it recommends who to connect with and when to follow up; no weekly list is described.
Chrome extension scans a LinkedIn profile and returns section-by-section guidance with a score.
Features page lists an ATS score for a resume against a job description and a score against best practices.
Resume optimizer flags missing keywords and mismatched skills against a job description and offers edits tailored to that job.
Job tracker page lists a Skill Gap Analyzer marked limited.
